package orders

// Inert source fixture. Imported as text; never executed by tests or Mocker.
// The registry binds an HTTP operation to its business handler. Its HTTP
// decoding/response adapter is outside this captured source scope.
type HTTPRegistry interface {
    Handle(pattern string, handler func(context.Context, *sql.DB, int64, string) error)
}

func registerCancel(registry HTTPRegistry) {
    registry.Handle("POST /orders/{id}/cancel", cancelOrder)
}

func cancelOrder(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, id int64, status string) error {
    tx, err := db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
    if err != nil { return err }
    query := "UPDATE orders SET status = $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING status"
    err = tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, query, status, id).Scan(&status)
    if err != nil {
        tx.Rollback()
        return err
    }
    return tx.Commit()
}

func inspectAllOrders(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) {
    // Caller and concrete result columns are outside this captured scope.
    db.QueryContext(ctx, "SELECT * FROM orders")
}
